components.name: Button
components.description: Button — triggers an action. Hierarchy: Primary (one per view), Secondary, Tertiary (low emphasis, not underlined at rest), Destructive (irreversible; meaning must be in the label). Size: md default; lg prominent/mobile; sm RESTRICTED to dense Desktop/Tablet data contexts with a 44×44 effective target. STATE SIGNALS: Hover = label underline, background unchanged (Tertiary also keeps its subtle hover background) — pointer devices only (@media (hover: hover)). Pressed = pressed background/colour, NO underline (Pressed takes precedence over Hover). Focus = focus ring only (:focus-visible; in production can combine with Hover). Disabled = disabled treatment, never underlined. Loading (Boolean) = never underlined; turn Leading/Trailing icon off when on; do not combine with Disabled or Pressed. The hover-underline layer is a Figma representation of CSS text-decoration. Disabled: native disabled or aria-disabled per the architecture doc. Navigation → use Link. Spec: chavosh-button-architecture.md

variables.name: color/action/destructive/background/default
variables.description: Fill of destructive actions (delete, cancel payment). Brand-independent red; separate intent from feedback/error. 7.4:1 with white foreground.

variables.name: color/action/destructive/background/pressed
variables.description: Destructive action fill while pressed. Brand-independent red.

variables.name: color/action/destructive/foreground/default
variables.description: Label, icon and spinner on the destructive action fill. White (7.4:1 on the default fill).

variables.name: color/action/disabled/background
variables.description: Shared disabled fill for all action hierarchies (Button, Icon Button). Separate intent from surface/disabled.

variables.name: color/action/disabled/foreground
variables.description: Shared disabled label, icon and spinner for all action hierarchies. 3.4:1 on white; state must also be exposed programmatically (disabled / aria-disabled).

variables.name: color/action/primary/background/default
variables.description: Fill of the primary action (Primary Button / Icon Button). 10.5:1 against its white foreground in both brands. One primary action per view.

variables.name: color/action/primary/background/pressed
variables.description: Primary action fill while pressed (darkest step of the primary role).

variables.name: color/action/primary/foreground/default
variables.description: Label, icon and spinner on the primary action fill. White in both brands (10.5:1 on the default fill).

variables.name: color/action/secondary/background/default
variables.description: Fill of the secondary action (outlined Button / Icon Button). White so the brand outline carries the hierarchy.

variables.name: color/action/secondary/background/pressed
variables.description: Secondary action fill while pressed.

variables.name: color/action/secondary/border/default
variables.description: Outline of the secondary action. Meets 3:1 so the action boundary is perceivable.

variables.name: color/action/secondary/border/hover
variables.description: Outline of the secondary action on hover and pressed.

variables.name: color/action/secondary/foreground/default
variables.description: Label and icon of the secondary action. Uses the brand secondary role (indigo in Financial, navy in Invest). 7.4:1 on white.

variables.name: color/action/secondary/foreground/hover
variables.description: Label and icon of the secondary action on hover and pressed.

variables.name: color/action/tertiary/background/hover
variables.description: Tertiary action background on hover. Default has no fill (transparent in code).

variables.name: color/action/tertiary/background/pressed
variables.description: Tertiary action background while pressed. Brand-tinted; distinct intent from selection/background even where values match.

variables.name: color/action/tertiary/foreground/default
variables.description: Label and icon of the tertiary (low-emphasis, no-container) action. Not underlined: underlines are reserved for links. 7.4:1 on white.

variables.name: color/action/tertiary/foreground/hover
variables.description: Tertiary action label and icon on hover and pressed.

variables.name: color/border/disabled
variables.description: Boundary of disabled controls. 1.84:1 on white, 1.6:1 on surface/disabled: perceivable structure without appearing interactive (enabled border/input is 5.0:1).

variables.name: color/focus/indicator
variables.description: Keyboard focus indicator: 3px ring next to the component (outline in production). Brand-independent; paired with focus/outer, ≥9:1 between them (WCAG C40 two-tone). Used by every interactive component.

variables.name: color/focus/outer
variables.description: Outer 2px focus ring that carries contrast on light surfaces. Always paired with focus/indicator. Brand-independent.

variables.name: focus/width/indicator
variables.description: Width of the main focus ring drawn directly around the focused element; pairs with color/focus/indicator. Always used with focus/width/outer; never for borders. In forced-colours mode, both rings become one system outline.

variables.name: focus/width/outer
variables.description: Width of the contrast ring drawn outside the main focus ring; pairs with color/focus/outer so focus stays visible on any background. Always used with focus/width/indicator.

variables.name: font/family/sans
variables.description: The shared typeface for all interface and content text across brands. Applied through the system's text styles.

variables.name: font/line-height/label/md
variables.description: Line height for the label/md text role; use only with font/size/label/md.

variables.name: font/line-height/label/sm
variables.description: Line height for the label/sm text role; use only with font/size/label/sm.

variables.name: font/size/label/md
variables.description: Font size for standard labels on controls and fields. Distinguished from body text by weight, not size.

variables.name: font/size/label/sm
variables.description: Font size for compact labels, e.g. in small controls.

variables.name: font/weight/medium
variables.description: Weight for labelling and interactive text: button, link and field labels (label/*) and mid-size data (data/md). Separates labels from body text without heading emphasis.

variables.name: radius/md
variables.description: Prominent action controls and raised or contained surfaces, e.g. Buttons and the Listbox overlay.

variables.name: size/control/height/lg
variables.description: Prominent height for high-emphasis actions, such as primary calls to action on mobile.

variables.name: size/control/height/md
variables.description: Default height for interactive controls (Button, Icon Button, Text Field, Select). Use unless the restricted small or prominent large height applies. Acts as a minimum when content wraps.

variables.name: size/control/height/sm
variables.description: RESTRICTED. For dense, pointer-first Desktop and Tablet contexts only (tables, filter bars, toolbars). Not the default and not the accessible minimum; never on Mobile or native. The hit area must still reach size/touch-target/min.

variables.name: size/icon/lg
variables.description: Large icon size for large controls and prominent actions. Not for icons inline with text.

variables.name: size/icon/md
variables.description: Default icon size, paired with body/md and label/md text in standard controls and fields.

variables.name: size/icon/sm
variables.description: Compact icon size, paired with small text (label/sm, body/sm) in small Buttons and Links.

variables.name: space/component/lg
variables.description: Left and right padding for compact actions, e.g. small Buttons.

variables.name: space/component/xl
variables.description: Left and right padding for standard and large Buttons.

variables.name: space/gap/sm
variables.description: Default gap between parts of one component: icon to label in Button, label to input and icon to value in Text Field.
